name: Lawfulness
verbatim_definition: Processing activities must be founded on at least one legal ground.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Fairness
verbatim_definition: This principle encompasses data subjects' positive expectations regarding processing activities or their awareness of the processing, especially when the processing is legally permitted to occur by a law. Furthermore, fairness involves conducting a just assessment of processing activities; if the processing negatively impacts data subjects, it would be considered unfair.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Transparency
verbatim_definition: Processing activities should be conducted in a transparent and open manner by effectively informing data subjects.
comparative_note: although missing in the KVKK, these principles are found in the guidelines and decisions of the Authority. Moreover, the transparency principle should be construed as an extension of the fairness principle. (Develioğlu, 2017, s. 45)
kvkk_status: not expressly stated in the KVKK
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Accountability
verbatim_definition: Controllers are obligated to demonstrate and furnish proof of compliance with the GDPR and KVKK for all processing activities.
comparative_note: although missing in the KVKK, these principles are found in the guidelines and decisions of the Authority. Moreover, while accountability is considered a principle in the GDPR, it is, in fact, more of a responsibility for the controller (Besemer, 2020, p.96). These obligations include the requirement to register with the Register of Controllers, maintain an inventory, publish a personal data retention and destruction policy, and establish a policy regarding special categories of personal data (Kaya, 2021).
kvkk_status: not expressly stated in the KVKK
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Purpose Limitation
verbatim_definition: Controllers must confine the utilization of processed personal data to the intended legitimate purpose of processing.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Data Minimization
verbatim_definition: Controllers should only process the minimal and relevant personal data necessary to achieve their intended purpose. This emphasizes the requirement for personal data processing to be both necessary and proportional to the specified purpose.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Accuracy
verbatim_definition: Controllers are obliged to ensure the correctness and currency of the personal data they process.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Storage Limitation
verbatim_definition: Personal data of data subjects should be stored only for as long as necessary for processing purposes.
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf

name: Integrity and Confidentiality
verbatim_definition: Controllers are required to exert efforts to ensure the security and integrity of their personal data, both technically and operationally.
comparative_note: although missing in the KVKK, these principles are validated under the scope of Art. 12 of the KVKK.
kvkk_status: not expressly stated in the KVKK
source_document: KB 2/Turkey/Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law - KVKK).pdf
